what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved a notice of intent for a garage addition at 48 Island Road, excluding one annotated tree outside the limit of work.
It approved the 171 Arbor Street three-lot common driveway notice of intent with added conditions, and approved paving a driveway at 181 Reservoir Road.
Four hearings were continued to November 6, including 701 Reservoir Road, 390 Howard Street, Electric Ave and Pierce Ave, and 48 Pearl Street.
The commission voted to take no action on the 564 Page Street certificate of compliance until the applicant sends a letter in the spring.
It approved spending up to a set cap from the Hall fund on used cabinets for Hollis Road; the administrator was assigned enforcement follow-ups.

why_it_matters: These votes decide what neighbours and applicants may build near wetlands, and the continued hearings leave several projects without a decision until November 6.
The Hall fund vote and the discussion of a roof estimate before the town budget cycle point to a possible request for town money for the Hollis Road building.
watch_next: The November 6 Conservation Commission meeting, where four continued hearings and the 22 Fairview Road continuation are expected.
The administrator's advice from town counsel on Fire Road enforcement, including possible daily fines, and the Hollis Road roof estimate.
